description: Threads keyword search — posts with engagement + media. orderBy relevant | post_dated | engagement. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.

orderBy.description: Sort the fetched page: relevant (default, Meta Top / similar to query), post_dated (newest publishedAt first), or engagement (likes+replies+reposts+quotes+views). Unknown values are 400.

q.description: Keyword or phrase to search public Threads posts (min 2 characters).

name: threads_search
